venues.name: Lightbox Film Center
venues.address: 1901 S 9th St (Bok Building; also listed as 800 Mifflin St)
venues.profile: Repertory, new restorations, experimental, silents with live music
venues.notes: Formerly at International House (to 2019) and UArts (2019–May 2024). Reconstituted as a nonprofit after UArts closure; screens at Bok. ADA entrance: 821 Dudley St. Bok has also hosted Bok Movie Club and Secret Cinema. UPDATE 2026-09-16: screens at Bok Auditorium in South Philadelphia, not the former UArts address. Dated listings live on TicketLeap, not the Lightbox site; when the TicketLeap…

venues.name: Woodmere Art Museum – Tuesday Nights at the Movies
venues.operator: Chestnut Hill Film Group (volunteer) with Woodmere
venues.profile: Classic, rare and underseen films; occasional silents with live score. Doors 6:30 PM, film 7:00–9:00 PM, $10 suggested donation. Season runs fall through early winter.
venues.notes: Woodmere appears under two domains (woodmereartmuseum.org and woodmeremuseum.org) — confirm canonical before scraping. UPDATE 2026-09-16: donation is now $10 suggested (was listed free/donation) and doors are 6:30 PM. Confirm the season's first Tuesday before listing an early-September date — the fall season has started as late as the last Tuesday in September.
